items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: My mother's father was Lewis Taylor, who was a huntsman and a carpenter.

ctx.x: What was your mother's maiden name?

Taylor. My mother's father was Lewis Taylor, who was a huntsman and a carpenter. And he was a pretty rough character. Lewis, they used to call him tits because he was a good man with his hands. You see tits, you hit your tit for tat and used to knock a lot of people out. That's what youngsters would fight with their hands, you know. My grandmother, I don't know too much about her because, you see, she died something. She went on to a grocery or something. And what happened was that on her way back home from what…
And that concert you said your mother promoted, do you remember who the musicians were?
